_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Session C2: plan ru_probe_long — russian_retail, the fifth AMENDMENT_1 file, whose rows are three to five times longer than the others', with iris as the anchor — on four models: the Mistral-Nemo / Vikhr-Nemo pair first, one per card, then the YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B pair on whichever card frees first. It completes the H2 family's files for these four models (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md Part VI) and is the Nemo pair's first session on transformers 5.14.1: iris must return 51/142 and 32/142 as in every earlier session, or the old and new numbers of this pair are not compared directly. Each run deletes its model's weights from the cache once its results are written (--free-weights-after), so that the disk never holds more than the two Nemo checkpoints at once, which it did in E1 and E2.
